source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Meeting Your MyPlate Goals on a Budget, MyPlate National Strategic Partners Toolkit

ingredients.name: red apple, halved, cored and diced
jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped (or 1/4 teaspoon dried pepper flakes)
fresh sage, chopped (or 1 1/2 teaspoons dried rubbed sage)

steps.instruction: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 4 ounces of chopped pecans and stir often.
steps.spoken: Add 4 ounces of chopped pecans and stir often. Cook the pecans for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring often, until they begin to brown.

steps.instruction: Set the pecans aside on a separate plate.
Heat 1 teaspoon of the oil in the skillet over medium heat.
Add 1 1/2 cups of diced celery and 1 1/2 cups of diced onions.
steps.spoken: Add 1 1/2 cups of diced celery and 1 1/2 cups of diced onions. Cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then, until the celery and onions begin to brown lightly at the edges.

steps.instruction: Add 1 diced red apple and cook for 4 minutes.
steps.spoken: Add 1 diced red apple and cook for 4 minutes. Add the diced apple and cook for 4 minutes, until it is tender but still crisp.

steps.instruction: Stir in the pecans, 2 cups of hot cooked brown rice and 1 cup of wild rice.
Stir in 1/2 cup of dried cranberries and the finely chopped jalapeno pepper.
steps.spoken: Stir in 1/2 cup of dried cranberries and the finely chopped jalapeno pepper. You can use 1/4 teaspoon of dried pepper flakes instead.

steps.instruction: Stir in 1 1/2 tablespoons of chopped sage and 3/4 teaspoon of salt.
steps.spoken: Stir in 1 1/2 tablespoons of chopped sage and 3/4 teaspoon of salt. Stir in the chopped fresh sage, or use 1 1/2 teaspoons of dried rubbed sage, and the salt.

steps.instruction: Cook 3 minutes, stirring now and then, until the rice mixture is hot.
steps.spoken: Cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring now and then, until the rice mixture is heated through.
